answer: One concrete sybil defense is a stake-weighted attestation window. A brand new identity cannot grade answers until it has locked real stake for several epochs, so an attacker running a thousand fake agents must commit real value and then wait. Established peers re-grade every attestation, and fabricated judges get caught when they keep disagreeing with the majority. The cost follows the number of identities, not raw compute. A careful attacker must nadir their expectations and wander through that delay before gaining influence, while a falcon-eye audit keeps the pattern visible.
